bodies: International Society of Certified Electronics Technicians (ISCET)
North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners (NABCEP)
National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)

exams.name: BICSI Installer 2 and Technician (INSTC/TECH)
exams.blurb: Credentials covering installation, termination and testing of copper and fiber cabling pathways and spaces.

exams.name: ETA Associate Electronics Technician (CETa)
exams.blurb: Foundational electronics credential covering basic DC/AC theory, test equipment and safety for entry technicians.

exams.name: ETA Certified Electronics Technician (CET)
exams.blurb: Mid-level credential covering communications, digital and analog electronics for consumer and industrial service.

exams.name: ETA Certified Journeyman Lineman
exams.blurb: Credential covering electrical distribution, climbing, safety and switching for overhead and underground power line workers.

exams.name: ETA Fiber Optics Installer/Technician
exams.blurb: Credential covering splicing, termination and testing of fiber optic cable for communications and data networks.

exams.name: ETA Renewable Energy Photovoltaic Installer
exams.blurb: Credential covering safe installation and commissioning of residential and small commercial photovoltaic systems.

exams.name: ISCET Certified Electronics Technician
exams.body: International Society of Certified Electronics Technicians (ISCET)
exams.blurb: Credential covering consumer electronics, communications and industrial electronic service and troubleshooting.

exams.name: NABCEP Battery Storage Installation Professional
exams.body: North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners (NABCEP)
exams.blurb: Credential covering design and installation of energy storage systems paired with PV or standalone storage.

exams.name: NABCEP PV Commissioning and Maintenance Specialist
exams.body: North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners (NABCEP)
exams.blurb: Credential covering inspection, testing, commissioning and O&M of installed photovoltaic systems.

exams.name: NABCEP PV Design Specialist
exams.body: North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners (NABCEP)
exams.blurb: Credential covering electrical and mechanical design of PV systems and interpretation of the National Electrical Code.

exams.name: NABCEP PV Installation Professional
exams.body: North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners (NABCEP)
exams.blurb: Top photovoltaic credential covering design, installation and commissioning of grid-direct and battery-based PV systems.

exams.name: NABCEP PV Installer Specialist
exams.body: North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners (NABCEP)
exams.blurb: Entry-to-mid credential for technicians performing hands-on PV installation under a certified professional.

exams.name: NABCEP PV System Inspector
exams.body: North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners (NABCEP)
exams.blurb: Credential for inspectors and authorities having jurisdiction to evaluate PV system code compliance.

exams.name: NABCEP PV Technical Sales
exams.body: North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners (NABCEP)
exams.blurb: Credential covering site assessment, system sizing and customer proposals for solar photovoltaic sales.

exams.name: NABCEP Solar Heating Installer
exams.body: North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners (NABCEP)
exams.blurb: Credential covering design and installation of solar thermal water and space heating systems.

exams.name: NCCER Electrician Certification
exams.blurb: Module-based apprenticeship training in electrical theory, wiring, motors and the National Electrical Code.

exams.name: NICET Site Security Integration (SSI) Level I
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: New 2026 certification covering installation and integration of electronic security systems such as access control and CCTV.

exams.name: NICET Site Security Integration (SSI) Level II
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Advanced 2026 certification covering design, commissioning and troubleshooting of integrated electronic security systems.

exams.name: NICET Voice Data Video (VDV) Level I
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Entry certification covering low-voltage cabling, pathways and basic installation of voice, data and video systems.

exams.name: NICET Voice Data Video (VDV) Level II
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Intermediate certification covering design support, testing and troubleshooting of structured cabling systems.

exams.name: NICET Voice Data Video (VDV) Level III
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Advanced certification covering system design, project management and code compliance for VDV systems.

exams.name: NICET Voice Data Video (VDV) Level IV
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Senior certification covering engineered VDV design, standards and oversight of large communications projects.

exams.name: ACI Concrete Construction Special Inspector
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection of concrete construction including pre-placement, sampling and field-cured testing.

exams.name: ACI Concrete Field Testing Technician Grade I
exams.blurb: Certifies field testing of fresh concrete: slump, temperature, air content, density and compressive cylinders.

exams.name: ACI Concrete Field Testing Technician Grade II
exams.blurb: Advanced field testing covering additional methods, aggregates and strength test specimens for concrete.

exams.name: ACI Concrete Strength Testing Technician
exams.blurb: Certifies capping, preparing and breaking cylinders to determine compressive strength of hardened concrete.

exams.name: ACI Flatwork Finisher Certification
exams.blurb: Certifies finishing of slabs, walks and floors including screeding, floating, troweling and jointing.

exams.name: ACI Pervious Concrete Certification
exams.blurb: Certifies mixing, placing and finishing of pervious concrete used for stormwater management pavements.

exams.name: ACI Post-Tensioning Field Personnel
exams.blurb: Certifies installation, stressing and grouting of post-tensioning tendons in reinforced concrete structures.

exams.name: ACI Shotcrete Nozzleman
exams.blurb: Certifies nozzle operation and placement of wet- or dry-mix shotcrete for structural and repair work.

exams.name: ALOA Certified Master Locksmith (CML)
exams.blurb: Highest locksmith credential covering complex master key systems, high-security locks and forensic locksmithing.

exams.name: ALOA Certified Professional Locksmith (CPL)
exams.blurb: Mid-level locksmith credential covering advanced locking devices, master keying and access control fundamentals.

exams.name: ALOA Certified Professional Safe Technician (CPS)
exams.blurb: Specialty credential covering safe manipulation, drilling, combination changing and vault service.

exams.name: ALOA Certified Registered Locksmith (CRL)
exams.blurb: Foundational locksmith credential covering key duplication, lock picking, installation and basic security hardware.

exams.name: Certified Flooring Installers (CFI)
exams.blurb: Certifies installers of carpet, hardwood, laminate and resilient flooring through hands-on performance testing.

exams.name: Certified Tile Installer (CTI)
exams.blurb: Hands-on credential verifying proper ceramic and stone tile installation, substrate prep and waterproofing.

exams.name: NAEC Certified Accessibility Technician (CAT)
exams.blurb: Certifies technicians servicing vertical platform and wheelchair lifts for accessibility compliance.

exams.name: NAEC Certified Elevator Technician (CET)
exams.blurb: Certifies elevator and escalator maintenance technicians across electrical, hydraulic and traction systems.

exams.name: National Glass Association Certified Glass Technician (CGT)
exams.blurb: Certifies glaziers in fabrication, installation and sealing of architectural glass and storefront systems.

exams.name: NRCA ProCert Roof System Installer
exams.blurb: Certifies installers of specific roof systems including asphalt, thermoplastic and modified bitumen membranes.

exams.name: QEI Qualified Elevator Inspector Level 1 (Elevators)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspectors of elevators for jurisdictions enforcing ASME A17.1 and A17.2 safety codes.

exams.name: QEI Qualified Inspector Level 2 (Escalators/Moving Walks)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspectors of escalators and moving walks for compliance with ASME A17.1 and A17.2.

exams.name: QEI Qualified Inspector Level 3 (Material/Wheelchair Lifts)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspectors of material and wheelchair lifts for compliance with ASME A18.1 safety standards.

exams.name: SAIA Scaffold Competent Person / Supervisor (SST)
exams.blurb: Certifies competent persons and supervisors for scaffold erection, inspection and fall protection compliance.

exams.name: AMPP Cathodic Protection Level 1
exams.blurb: Entry credential on corrosion control and cathodic protection testing for underground and submerged metallic structures.

exams.name: AMPP Cathodic Protection Level 2
exams.blurb: Intermediate credential covering design, installation and troubleshooting of cathodic protection systems in the field.

exams.name: AMPP Coating Inspector Program Level 1
exams.blurb: Entry coating inspection credential covering surface preparation, application and inspection of protective coatings on structures.

exams.name: AMPP Coating Inspector Program Level 2
exams.blurb: Intermediate coating inspection credential adding specification review, advanced test methods and coating failure analysis.

exams.name: AMPP Coating Inspector Program Level 3
exams.blurb: Senior coating inspector credential covering programme management, standards and peer review for major projects.

exams.name: AMPP Protective Coatings Specialist (PCS)
exams.blurb: Credential recognising advanced technical knowledge of protective coatings, corrosion and specification for senior specialists.

exams.name: API 1104 Pipeline Welder Qualification
exams.blurb: Qualification to weld transmission pipelines per API 1104, covering procedure, visual inspection and destructive testing.

exams.name: ASME Section IX Welder and Procedure Qualification
exams.blurb: Qualification under the ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code covering welder performance and welding procedure specs.

exams.name: AWS Certified Associate Welding Inspector (CAWI)
exams.blurb: Entry-level inspection credential for those not yet eligible for the CWI, covering basic welding inspection fundamentals.

exams.name: AWS Certified Welder Program
exams.blurb: Performance qualification testing welders to a specific code and procedure, with results logged in the AWS national database.

exams.name: AWS Certified Welding Educator (CWE)
exams.blurb: Credential for instructors who teach welding, verifying knowledge of welding theory, practice and AWS education standards.

exams.name: AWS Certified Welding Engineer (CWEng)
exams.blurb: Advanced engineering credential covering weld design, metallurgy, procedure qualification and failure analysis of structures.

exams.name: AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI)
exams.blurb: Widely recognised inspection credential covering welding processes, codes, procedures, discontinuities and weld testing.

exams.name: AWS Certified Welding Sales Representative (CWSR)
exams.blurb: Credential for sales staff covering welding consumables, equipment, codes and matching products to fabrication needs.

exams.name: AWS Certified Welding Supervisor (CWS)
exams.blurb: Management credential covering welding production planning, quality control, costing and supervision of welding personnel.

exams.name: AWS D1.1 Structural Steel Code Endorsement
exams.blurb: Optional CWI add-on testing knowledge of the AWS D1.1 structural steel welding code for building and bridge fabrication.

exams.name: AWS Radiographic Interpreter (RI)
exams.blurb: Credential covering interpretation of radiographic film and digital images of welds to locate and classify discontinuities.

exams.name: AWS Senior Certified Welding Inspector (SCWI)
exams.blurb: Advanced credential for CWIs with extra experience, qualifying holders to supervise inspections and certify procedures.

exams.name: Certified Robotic Arc Welding (CRAW)
exams.blurb: Credential verifying a technician can set up, operate and troubleshoot robotic arc welding cells in automated fabrication.

exams.name: NCCER Welding Certification
exams.blurb: Module-based craft training in SMAW, GMAW, FCAW and GTAW culminating in a verifiable welding credential and transcript.

exams.name: NIMS Welding Credentials
exams.blurb: Job-skill credentials in welding, cutting and thermal joining aligned to national metalworking standards for manufacturing.

exams.name: ICC Accessibility Inspector/Plans Examiner
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection and plan review for accessibility compliance under the ICC A117.1 standard and the ADA.

exams.name: ICC Building Plans Examiner (B3)
exams.blurb: Certifies review of construction documents for code compliance before permits are issued under the IBC.

exams.name: ICC Certified Building Official (CBO)
exams.blurb: Senior credential for officials responsible for overall code administration and enforcement in a jurisdiction.

exams.name: ICC Combination Residential Inspector (R2)
exams.blurb: Certifies combined building, mechanical, plumbing and electrical inspection of one- and two-family dwellings.

exams.name: ICC Commercial Building Inspector (B2)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection of commercial and multifamily buildings for compliance with the International Building Code.

exams.name: ICC Commercial Electrical Inspector (E2)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection of commercial electrical systems for compliance with the IBC and National Electrical Code.

exams.name: ICC Commercial Mechanical Inspector (M2)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection of commercial HVAC and mechanical systems for compliance with the International Mechanical Code.

exams.name: ICC Commercial Plumbing Inspector (P2)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection of commercial plumbing systems for compliance with the International Plumbing Code.

exams.name: ICC Electrical Plans Examiner (E3)
exams.blurb: Certifies plan review of electrical drawings against the National Electrical Code and applicable building codes.

exams.name: ICC Energy Conservation Inspector/Plans Examiner
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection and plan review of building envelopes and systems for compliance with the Energy Conservation Code.

exams.name: ICC Existing Building Inspector
exams.blurb: Certifies evaluation and code compliance of alterations, repairs and change of occupancy in existing buildings under the IEBC.

exams.name: ICC Fire Inspector II (F2)
exams.blurb: Certifies conduct of fire inspections, hazard correction and code enforcement under the International Fire Code.

exams.name: ICC Green Building Inspector/Plans Examiner
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection and plan review of sustainable construction under the International Green Construction Code (IgCC).

exams.name: ICC Master Code Professional (MCP)
exams.blurb: Highest ICC credential recognising broad mastery across multiple code disciplines and inspection certifications.

exams.name: ICC Permit Technician
exams.blurb: Certifies administrative staff who issue permits, review submittals and manage code-related records for a jurisdiction.

exams.name: ICC Property Maintenance and Housing Inspector (H2)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection of existing structures for safety, sanitation and maintenance under the Property Maintenance Code.

exams.name: ICC Residential Building Inspector (B1)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection of one- and two-family dwellings and townhouses for compliance with the International Residential Code.

exams.name: ICC Residential Electrical Inspector (E1)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection of electrical installations in dwellings for compliance with the IRC and National Electrical Code.

exams.name: ICC Residential Mechanical Inspector (M1)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection of HVAC and mechanical systems in dwellings for compliance with the International Residential Code.

exams.name: ICC Residential Plumbing Inspector (P1)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection of plumbing systems in dwellings for compliance with the International Residential Code.

exams.name: NFPA Certified Fire Inspector I (CFI-I)
exams.blurb: Certifies conduct of fire inspections, hazard identification and code enforcement per NFPA 1031.

exams.name: NFPA Certified Fire Plan Examiner (CFPE)
exams.blurb: Certifies review of fire protection drawings and specifications for code compliance before construction approval.

exams.name: NFPA Certified Fire Protection Specialist (CFPS)
exams.blurb: Global credential covering fire prevention, protection technology, codes and risk analysis for fire protection professionals.

exams.name: NFPA Certified Water-Based Systems Professional (CWBSP)
exams.blurb: Certifies design and analysis of automatic sprinkler and water-based fire protection systems per NFPA 13, 20 and 25.

exams.name: NICET Fire Alarm Systems Level I
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Entry certification covering basic fire alarm system components, inspection and documentation for junior technicians.

exams.name: NICET Fire Alarm Systems Level II
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Intermediate certification covering system layout, installation, testing and code requirements for fire alarm systems.

exams.name: NICET Fire Alarm Systems Level III
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Advanced certification covering engineering analysis, system design and complex fire alarm project management.

exams.name: NICET Fire Alarm Systems Level IV
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Senior certification covering fire alarm engineering, code interpretation and oversight of large engineered systems.

exams.name: NICET Inspection and Testing of Fire Alarm Systems Level I
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection, testing and maintenance of installed fire alarm systems and documentation of results.

exams.name: NICET Inspection and Testing of Fire Alarm Systems Level II
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Advanced certification covering complex fire alarm system ITM, troubleshooting and code-compliant reporting.

exams.name: NICET Inspection and Testing of Water-Based Systems Level I
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection and testing of sprinkler and water-based systems for proper operation and code compliance.

exams.name: NICET Inspection and Testing of Water-Based Systems Level II
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Advanced certification covering complex water-based system ITM, flow testing and deficiency correction.

exams.name: NICET Special Hazards Suppression Systems Level I
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Entry certification covering installation and testing of gaseous, foam and other special suppression systems.

exams.name: NICET Special Hazards Suppression Systems Level II
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Advanced certification covering design, commissioning and ITM of special hazard fire suppression systems.

exams.name: NICET Water-Based Systems Layout Level I
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Entry certification covering basics of sprinkler system layout, hydraulics and related reference standards.

exams.name: NICET Water-Based Systems Layout Level II
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Intermediate certification covering detailed sprinkler system calculations, drawings and code compliance.

exams.name: NICET Water-Based Systems Layout Level III
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Advanced certification covering complex water-based layout, special hazards and engineering review.

exams.name: NICET Water-Based Systems Layout Level IV
exams.body: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET)
exams.blurb: Senior certification covering engineered fire protection design, standards and project oversight.
